ConsumableDesc:
Drag onto a character to remove all of their equipped gears.
This item will disappear after use.

Drag onto a character to remove all of their equipped gears. Can be used infinitely.
While holding this item, obtaining another Disassembly Wrench will result in obtaining 1 Gold Coin instead.

***"Armed to the teeth? Let's pull those out too."***

Drag onto a piece of gear to transform it into a random piece of the same type.
Drag onto a character to remove all their equipped gears and transform the gear into random gear of the same type.
This item will disappear after use.

Drag onto an advanced equipment to convert it into the corresponding privileged equipment.
Drag onto a character to select one of their equipped advanced equipment to convert into privileged equipment.
This item will disappear after use.

***"Card swap! Equipment evolution!"***

Drag onto a <color=ff>3-cost** or lower character to create a copy of that character with 1-star in the preparation area.
This item will disappear after use.

***"HR's favorite tool. It has greatly eased the workforce shortage."***

Drag onto any character to create a copy of that character with 1-star in the preparation area.
This item will disappear after use.

***"HR's favorite tool. It has greatly eased the workforce shortage."***

Drag onto a character to use. Select to gain one item from the four recommended advanced equipment for that character.
This item will disappear after use.

Drag onto a piece of advanced equipment to use it, turning it into the corresponding privileged equipment. It initially has a set number of uses.
Grants 1 additional use for every <unbreak>15</unbreak> Store refresh(es).
***"Sorry, having privileges really means you can do whatever you want."***

Drag onto a **1-cost** character to create a 1-star copy of that character in the preparation area.
This item will disappear after use.

***"HR's favorite tool. It has greatly eased the workforce shortage."***

Drag onto a character to use. You can select Plot Armor 1 time.
This item disappears after use.
***"All eyes on me! I hereby declare: I'm the main character!"***

Drag onto a <color=ff>1-Cost** "Trailblaze Silver Rail" character to use, creating a 1-star copy of this character in the preparation area.
This item disappears after use.

Drag onto a <color=ff>3-Cost** or lower "Trailblaze Silver Rail" character to use, creating a 1-star copy of this character in the preparation area.
This item disappears after use.

Drag onto any "Trailblaze Silver Rail" character to use, creating a 1-star copy of this character in the preparation area.
This item disappears after use.

Drag onto the Aha indicator to use. Removes all Aha Equipment.
This item disappears after use.

Drag onto the Aha Indicator to use. Select one piece of Aha Equipment to Recast it, then choose one of four same-type equipment pieces as the Recast result.
This item disappears after use.

Drag onto the Aha Indicator to use. Select one piece of Aha advanced equipment and convert it into the corresponding privileged equipment.
This item disappears after use.

Drag and drop onto the Beast Garden to use. Select 1 exclusive chimera for a character and obtain a 1-Star Copy of it.
This item disappears after use.

Drag onto the Beast Garden to use. Select 1 exclusive chimera for a character to increase its star rating by 1.
This item disappears after use.
